pattern: starting with you , each player votes for {w:VoteWords}
subject: none

examples.text: Starting with you, each player votes for carnage or homage. If carnage gets more votes, destroy all nonland permanents. If homage gets more votes or the vote is tied, draw a card.
Starting with you, each player votes for time or knowledge. If time gets more votes, take an extra turn after this one. If knowledge gets more votes or the vote is tied, draw three cards.

When ~ enters, starting with you, each player votes for death or torture. If death gets more votes, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice. If torture gets more votes or the vote is tied, each opponent loses 4 life.

counterExamples: Starting with you, each player votes for carnage or carnage.
Starting with you, each player votes for carnage or banana.
Starting with you, each player votes for carnage. If carnage gets more votes, draw a card.

examples.text: Starting with you, each player votes for a nonland permanent you don't control. Exile each permanent with the most votes or tied for most votes.

counterExamples: Starting with you, each player votes for target creature. Exile each permanent with the most votes or tied for most votes.
